n868bb13c8a4.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched? (Rock system – Minerals)
o: Archaean and Dharwar rocks – Metallic minerals
n868bb13c8a4.x: Archaean and Dharwar rocks hold metallic minerals. Gondwana rocks hold coal, Cuddapah/Vindhyan rocks hold barytes, asbestos, limestone and diamonds, and Tertiary rocks hold petroleum.

n4e8132aea10.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Eastern Ghats Mobile Belt – Bauxite, manganese and graphite
Cuddapah basin – Gold and iron ore
n4e8132aea10.x: The Cuddapah basin is associated with barytes and asbestos; gold and iron ore are linked with the Dharwar system.

nd0968054ca5.s: The North-Eastern Plateau mineral belt of India is rich in:
o: Coal, iron ore, manganese, mica, bauxite and copper
nd0968054ca5.x: The North-Eastern Plateau belt is rich in coal, iron ore, manganese, mica, bauxite and copper.

nchemistry-3-2.s: Which of the following ore–formula pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
nchemistry-3-2.x: Malachite is the basic carbonate Cu₂(CO₃)(OH)₂; Cu₂S is chalcocite.

nchemistry-3-45.s: Which of the following ore–formula pairs is correctly matched?
nchemistry-3-45.x: Cassiterite is SnO₂. Zinc blende is ZnS, cinnabar is HgS and argentite is Ag₂S.

nchemistry-3-73.s: Which of the following mineral–formula pairs is correctly matched?
nchemistry-3-73.x: Cryolite is Na₃AlF₆. Ilmenite is FeTiO₃, corundum is anhydrous Al₂O₃ and bauxite is hydrated Al₂O₃·xH₂O.

nchemistry-1-17.s: Which of the following metal–ore pairs is correctly matched?
nchemistry-1-17.x: Lead is obtained from galena. Mercury comes from cinnabar, silver from argentite and tin from cassiterite.

n140d7f31c8f.s: The Central mineral belt of India, with iron ore, manganese, coal and limestone, mainly covers:
n140d7f31c8f.x: The Central belt covers Chhattisgarh and Madhya Pradesh, with iron ore (Bailadila), manganese (Balaghat), coal and limestone.

n407ada63f32.s: Neyveli in the Southern mineral belt is a major area of:
n407ada63f32.x: Neyveli is a major lignite area of the Southern belt, which also has iron ore, gold, manganese and chromite.

n1d9197cdd72.s: Thummalapalli in YSR Kadapa district is known for deposits of:
n1d9197cdd72.x: Thummalapalli in YSR Kadapa is associated with uranium; Agnigundala and Bondalamottu in Guntur have copper, zinc and silver.

n06d85a9bfa9.s: The snow avalanche at Badrinath (Mana) in February 2025 killed workers of which organisation?
n06d85a9bfa9.x: The Badrinath-Mana avalanche resulted in the death of Border Roads Organisation workers.

n139226bdaa5.s: Which one of the following statements about cyclones in India is correct?
o: Cyclones affect only the east coast.
The Arabian Sea generates more cyclones than the Bay of Bengal.
All severe cyclones strike the west coast.
The Bay of Bengal generates about four times as many cyclones as the Arabian Sea.
n139226bdaa5.x: Both seas generate cyclones, but the Bay of Bengal produces about four times as many, so the east coast receives far more.

nab7049c6825.s: Telangana became the 29th State of India on:
nab7049c6825.x: Telangana became the 29th State of India on 2 June 2014.

ne25b213c6ff.s: Andhra State, regarded as the first linguistic State, was formed in which year?
ne25b213c6ff.x: Andhra State was formed in 1953 (1 October), and Andhra Pradesh followed in 1956.

nap-geography-27-4.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Coastal Andhra – Inland, south-western Andhra Pradesh
nap-geography-27-4.x: Rayalaseema is inland in south-western AP on uplands and plateau; Coastal Andhra lies in the east on low coastal plains.

n48254418e06.s: Which of the following rivers rise in the Eastern Ghats?
n48254418e06.x: The Vamsadhara, Nagavali and Sabari rise in the Eastern Ghats.

nap-geography-25-1.s: Which of the following peak–height pairs is correctly matched?
nap-geography-25-1.x: Mahendragiri is 1501 m. Jindhagada is 1690 m, Aroma 1680 m and Dolphin's Nose 335 m.

nap-geography-10-2.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nap-geography-10-2.x: Jindhagada is near Araku. Aroma is at Chintapalli and Mahendragiri lies in Odisha.

nap-geography-3-6.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nap-geography-3-6.x: The Gosthani meets the sea at Bheemunipatnam. The Penna is linked to Gandikota, the Vamsadhara enters AP at Pathapatnam and the Gundlakamma reaches the sea at Devarampadu.

nap-geography-4-4.s: Which of the following river–tributary pairs is correctly matched?
nap-geography-4-4.x: The Kalyani feeds the Swarnamukhi. The Mahendratanaya feeds the Vamsadhara, the Sileru the Sabari and Gadi Gedda the Champavathi.

nec796ec89b2.s: Polavaram on the Godavari is a National Project under which Section of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014?
nec796ec89b2.x: Polavaram is a multipurpose Godavari dam declared a National Project under Section 90 of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014.

nap-geography-7-4.s: Which of the following project–river pairs is correctly matched?
nap-geography-7-4.x: Somasila is on the Penna. The Cheyyeru Project is on the Cheyyeru, Tammileru Dam on the Tammileru and Vani Vilasa Sagar on the Vedavathi.

n3641e373eaa.s: About what share of Andhra Pradesh's annual rainfall occurs during October–December?
n3641e373eaa.x: AP lies between the south-west and north-east monsoon regimes, and about one-third of its rainfall falls in October–December.

n5a3d282fff2.s: The 1990 Andhra Pradesh cyclone, a turning point for disaster management, caused approximately how many deaths?
n5a3d282fff2.x: The 1990 Andhra Pradesh cyclone caused about 1,000 deaths and is regarded as a turning point for disaster management.

n5c0cfe8aa7b.s: During Cyclone Montha (2025), supported by the AWARE 2.0 early-warning platform, how many deaths were reported?
n5c0cfe8aa7b.x: With AWARE 2.0 supporting early warning during Montha in 2025, only 15 deaths were reported.

na8c731c5175.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched? (Flood measure – Category)
na8c731c5175.x: Detention basins are a structural measure, like embankments; forecasting and insurance are non-structural.

nd617f90294b.s: The Model Flood Plain Zoning Bill was circulated in:
nd617f90294b.x: The Model Flood Plain Zoning Bill was circulated in 1975.

ngeneral-geography-11-32.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
ngeneral-geography-11-32.x: Drainage planning reduces urban waterlogging. Hazard mapping identifies risk zones and flood forecasting provides early warning.

n104cf4e28f6.s: The Krishna Anicut at Bezwada (1853–1854) was built under the supervision of:
n104cf4e28f6.x: The Krishna Anicut at Bezwada was built in 1853–1854 under Charles Orr.

nd7d40497857.s: Which institution is the chief nodal agency for disaster management in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Andhra Pradesh State Disaster Management Authority
nd7d40497857.x: APSDMA, a statutory body under the DM Act, 2005 and the AP Disaster Management Rules, 2007, is the State's chief nodal agency.

na7fb3849806.s: Which Union ministry handles drought, pest attacks, hailstorms and frost/cold waves?
o: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
na7fb3849806.x: The Ministry of Agriculture handles drought, pest attacks, hailstorms and frost/cold waves; the Ministry of Home Affairs handles other notified disasters.

nap-geography-13-4.s: Which of the following forest type – region pairs is correctly matched?
o: Dry deciduous – Erstwhile Srikakulam and Visakhapatnam
Short thorn – Erstwhile Srikakulam and Visakhapatnam
Moist deciduous – Erstwhile Kadapa and Kurnool
Moist deciduous – Erstwhile Srikakulam, Visakhapatnam and East Godavari agency
nap-geography-13-4.x: Moist deciduous forests grow in old Srikakulam, Visakhapatnam and the East Godavari agency; dry deciduous and thorn forests are in Rayalaseema districts.

nap-geography-19-4.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Seshachalam Hills – Northern extent of AP forests
Nallamala Forests – Biggest forest in Andhra Pradesh
Simhachalam Hills – Western extent of AP forests
nap-geography-19-4.x: Nallamala is AP's biggest forest. Seshachalam is in southern AP, the Balaghat hills mark the western extent and Simhachalam the northern extent.

nd2d7bdbe858.s: Among pulses, black gram does best on which soil?
nd2d7bdbe858.x: Black gram does best on black soil, while red gram, green gram and horse gram suit red soil.

nap-geography-15-4.s: Which of the following soil–crop pairs is correctly matched?
nap-geography-15-4.x: Red soil suits groundnut. Delta alluvium grows rice, black soil is the cotton soil and laterite suits cashew.

nap-geography-20-4.s: Which of the following soil–area pairs is correctly matched in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Deep black soil – Adoni and Aluru
nap-geography-20-4.x: Deep black soil occurs at Adoni and Aluru. Alluvial soil is in the deltas and red soil in Rayalaseema.

n427e3100539.s: Which agro-climatic zone – soil pair of Andhra Pradesh is NOT correctly matched?
n427e3100539.x: The North Coastal zone is associated with laterite, not black soil; the Godavari zone has alluvium and the Scarce Rainfall zone red soil.

naac2602a588.s: Alkaline soils are reclaimed mainly by applying:
naac2602a588.x: Alkaline soils are improved by adding gypsum; saline soils instead need drainage and leaching.

nc6af6d41e1f.s: The principal uranium locality of Andhra Pradesh, with low-grade ore, is:
nc6af6d41e1f.x: Tummalapalle is the principal uranium locality of Andhra Pradesh, and its ore is low-grade.

n4e3bc11b6a2.s: Which of the following deposit–mineral pairs is correctly matched?
n4e3bc11b6a2.x: Gudur (Nellore) is a mica area. Mangampet has barytes, Tummalapalle uranium and Bhavanapadu beach sand minerals.

n3af15627b68.s: The Swarnagiri gold mine in Kurnool district is operated under a 30-year lease by:
n3af15627b68.x: The Swarnagiri mine in Tuggali mandal, Kurnool, is operated by GeoMysore Services under a 30-year lease.

nb7b903f6612.s: Which of the following region–feature pairs of Andhra Pradesh is correctly matched?
o: Humid coastal region – Low rainfall, droughts and extreme heat
Deltaic region – Cool conditions and high local rainfall
Semi-arid Rayalaseema – Low rainfall, droughts and extreme heat
Hill region – Fertile land fed by rivers
nb7b903f6612.x: Rayalaseema is semi-arid with low rainfall, droughts and extreme heat. The coast is humid and wet, the deltas fertile and river-fed, and the hills cool.

n2e6a745a4df.s: Which year was India's warmest since 1901, with 446 heatwave days?
n2e6a745a4df.x: 2024 was India's warmest year since 1901 and recorded 446 heatwave days.

ne7484eeabe5.s: Which of the following factor–effect pairs on population distribution is correctly matched?
o: Water – Plains are favoured over mountains
Landform – Fertile alluvium supports dense farming
Soil – River valleys support dense settlement
ne7484eeabe5.x: Moderate climate attracts population. Water relates to river valleys, landform to plains and soil to fertile alluvium.

n8a296e8efb0.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Brazil – Most populous country in South America
South America – Highest population growth rate
n8a296e8efb0.x: Brazil is the most populous country in South America. Africa has the highest growth rate and Asia is the densest continent.

n3cb6feb2419.s: The World Population Prospects, issued every two years since 1951, is published by:
n3cb6feb2419.x: World Population Prospects is published every two years by the UN Population Division and has been issued since 1951.
